reverify.expected: a census in pt-BR whose arrange.menus rows carry the same 609 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. conclusion: On this host in pt-BR, arrange.menus exposes 778 elements carrying 609 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.
290 window rows matched no surface rule and are not filed under any record; they are in the evidence file and can be re-classified when a rule exists.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.

2 strings are neither cited nor proved absent: each is absent from Apple's corpora as bytes and a shipped label folds to it (a colon, an ellipsis, a case), so the spelling Logic ships is not something this census read: 시스템 설정…; 최근 사용 항목
